scope: Real Three construction and source/control state checks. GPU compilation and rendered appearance require parent browser verification.
results: Accepted baseline hash is the exact source preserved before Studio changes
Actual Three geometry, five draws and fixed camera profile remain identical to accepted source
Absent look and explicit defaults preserve accepted audio, phase, travel and front values exactly
Static controls clamp to specified minima and maxima with motion frozen
Invalid look inputs resolve to finite defaults
Width and twist uniforms feed common architecture and peripheral placement shaders
Gloss applies to both dark wall and rib reflection bands, preserving accepted negative-Z support
Flight zero freezes travel only: real audio, bends and onset fronts remain active
Twice flight speed produces twice actual travel without changing front propagation
Host-scaled motion delta is accepted through 0.125 seconds without truncation or a second speed multiply
Particle density reduces actual whole-line draw count in both quality modes; structural draws are preserved
Particle glow changes filament light only and remains editable while frozen
Motion off freezes phase, real audio and fronts exactly while explicit look remains editable
Zero pulse gain immediately clears existing fronts while frozen and prevents new fronts while moving
Idle and inactive frames do not fabricate onset waves even at extreme flight speed
All nine palettes remain directly editable during a frozen pose
Long extreme flight remains finite and bounded
Every owned resource is disposed exactly once; later changes are inert
